question: Can development-based restart selection produce a reliable image model for unseen addition pairs?

dataset.split_rule: For each of 23 answers, eight unordered pairs train the model, two choose checkpoints and the restart, and two remain sealed for one final test.

model.family: shared numeral reader, symmetric two-operand transformer, continuous raster writer

optimization.batch_construction: One randomly chosen rendering from every training pair at each update.

evaluation.test_rule: Train all five restarts without test evaluation. Select one from development results. Evaluate the sealed test once.
evaluation.swap_audit: Exchange the two operand rasters for every test pair and run one more forward pass.

selection.rule: Within each restart, use highest development exact-raster rate, then development accuracy, then training exact-raster rate, then lowest development pixel error.

selection_across_seeds.rule: Choose the restart with highest development exact-raster rate, then development accuracy, then training exact-raster rate, then lowest development pixel error.

execution.backend: MLX on the M4 Mac mini
